subject: Recap + onramp plan: OptiMedIQ discovery -> POC kickoff
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@optimedIQ.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + initial onramp plan (post-demo)

Hi Alicia — great conversation yesterday, thanks for walking us through the retrieval use case and the examples. Quick recap so we’re aligned and can move to an operational kickoff: 

1) Pain points you highlighted
- Search/semantic recall latency for short-context queries (user-facing) — currently ~350ms p50, spikes above 700ms p95.
- High per-query inference cost for batched analytics flows (finance is tracking unit economics).
- Data controls & compliance: need private deployment options, audit logs (90d retention), and SOC2 evidence.

2) Pilot (6-week) scope we propose
- Target workload: clinical Q&A and document search (subset of 2500 records).
- Environment: start hosted with a reserved Dedicated pool for predictable throughput, plan migration to Private (VPC) during week 3 if network controls validated.
- Success metrics (quantifiable):
  * Latency: p95 < 150ms for short-context queries (first token to first token).
  * Accuracy: retrieval+rerank top-1 relevance >= 85% on the seeded prompt set.
  * Cost: reduce inference unit cost by 35–45% vs current baseline (we’ll converge on baseline during onboarding).
- Evaluation: 120 prompt/eval pairs (see attached POC_eval_prompt_set.csv). Pass threshold: 85% scaled accuracy and no regressions on safety checks.

3) Owners & roles
- OptiMedIQ: Alicia Gomez (product lead) — overall success & product validation; Rajiv Menon (infra) — network & credentials.
- Redwood: Soojin Lee (AE) — program lead; Karthik Iyer (SE) — technical owner and runbook; Monica Patel (CS) — prompt/eval support and rollout ops.

4) Timeline & first milestones
- Week 0 (this week): finalize MOU + kickoff meeting (proposed Wed, Apr 20, 10:00 PT).
- Week 1: access + dataset ingestion (read-only S3, sample 2k records), baseline run, confirm observability hooks.
- Week 2–3: evaluation sweep, prompt/eval tuning, optional private deployment validation.
- Week 4–6: stability, load test, handoff and rollout plan.

5) Immediate access checklist (required before kickoff)
- Create a read-only S3 bucket with sample dataset (S3 URI) and grant our se@redwood.com read access.
- Provide VPN/VPC peering details or allow the short-term staging API key (we prefer VPC peering for Private validation).
- Firewall rules: outbound to 52.3.201.0/24 (Redwood egress) + ports 443.
- Compliance: if you can share the SOC2 artifact (redacted), we’ll validate retention and audit log coverage.

Attachments: POC_eval_prompt_set.csv (prompt pairs + expected labels), redwood_onramp_network_requirements.pdf (network checklist).

Next step: can you confirm the Wed Apr 20, 10:00 PT kickoff and that Rajiv will own the infra checklist? If so I’ll send calendar invite + agenda and a short MOU to sign.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this to a short pilot.

Best,

--
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0124

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia@optimedIQ.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@optimedIQ.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 10:05:32 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + initial onramp plan (post-demo)

Thanks Soojin — this is great, and super helpful to see the proposed metrics. We’re aligned on the goals. A few clarifications from our side: 

- We do intend to prioritize private deployment because of PHI-related controls; however, we’re open to starting on Dedicated hosted for a fast baseline and moving to VPC peering as you suggested.
- SOC2: our compliance team needs a copy of Redwood’s SOC2 + attestations on logging and retention (90 days). Can we get that ahead of the kickoff?
- Timeline: Wed Apr 20, 10:00 PT works for Alicia + Rajiv. We’ll have Chris (data engineer) join the kickoff so he can start on the S3 setup immediately after the call.

Also: one ask — can you add an explicit eval gate for safety/sensitive content (medical hallucination checks)? We need automatic regression alerts if the model suggests anything outside of sourced docs.

If you can send the calendar invite I’ll accept and we’ll prepare our internal MOU to sign.

— Alicia
Product Lead, OptiMedIQ

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@optimedIQ.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@optimedIQ.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 10:20:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + initial onramp plan (post-demo)

Appreciate the quick reply, Alicia — yes we’ll add a safety/regression gate as a first-class metric. Concrete replies to your asks: 

- SOC2: I’ve requested the latest SOC2 Type II package from Security; I’ll share a redacted bundle prior to kickoff (tracking ticket: HS-6783).
- Safety gate: we’ll run the 120 prompt set through the hallucination detector and require zero high-severity hallucinations for the pass; medium-severity items trigger a remediation sprint. Monica will run the evals and alert on regressions.
- Deployment path: start Dedicated (reserved capacity) on week 0 to capture throughput & cost baseline, then do the VPC peering validation in week 2. Karthik will own the peering runbook and on-prem checklist.

Action items I’ll take now:
- Send calendar invite for Wed Apr 20, 10:00 PT (15–30 min kickoff).
- Upload the MOU (short form) to DocuSign and share link by EOD.
- Share a short staging API key with limited scope for initial smoke tests (expires in 7 days) once Rajiv confirms network readiness.

Can Rajiv confirm which of these options works for infra (VPC peering in week 2 vs temporary staging key for immediate smoke test)? Also, Alicia — please share Chris’s email so we can include him on the access checklist.

Thanks — sending the invite now.

— Soojin

From: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@optimedIQ.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Alicia Gomez <alicia@optimedIQ.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 11:02:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + initial onramp plan (post-demo)

On Thu, Apr 15, 2027 at 10:20 AM Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com> wrote:
> Can Rajiv confirm which of these options works for infra (VPC peering in week 2 vs temporary staging key for immediate smoke test)?

Hi all — we can do a quick staging key to unblock the baseline runs this week; Rajiv will coordinate the limited-scope key and we’ll rotate it after the smoke window.

I’ve attached a network diagram (optimed_network_egress_v1.pdf stub) showing our current egress restrictions — our infra team will open the outbound access to the Redwood egress range you listed once the MOU is signed.

We’ll also share Chris’s email in a follow-up (he’s copied on the kickoff invite). SOC2: our compliance folks will want the redacted Type II you mentioned; please send to compliance@optimedIQ.com (secure transfer preferred).

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

— Rajiv

Attachments: optimed_network_egress_v1.pdf (diagram, stub)
